title: Man dies after police restrain him
article: Provincial police are investigating the death of a man who was restrained by city officers after flying into a rage in a friend's apartment.

The 43-year-old man was pepper-sprayed and handcuffed by Montreal police, but the four officers called to the scene Sunday did not use excessive force, said Andre Champagne, a spokesperson for the ambulance company.
Ambulance workers were the first to arrive after a resident called 911 Sunday morning to say his friend was smashing objects in an east-end apartment.
"He said his friend was violent, agitated and required medical attention," said a provincial police spokesperson.
The man might have suffered a cardiac arrest during the incident, Champagne said.
